definitions.explanation: An extra amount added on top of a base price, fee, or quantity. Used in business, finance, and everyday contexts when something is added to an existing amount.

examples.japanese: {料金|りょうきん}に{手数料|てすうりょう}を{上乗|うわの}せする。
examples.english: Add a handling fee on top of the price.

examples.japanese: {燃料|ねんりょう}サーチャージが{航空券|こうくうけん}の{価格|かかく}に{上乗|うわの}せされている。
examples.english: A fuel surcharge is added on top of the airfare.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{値上|ねあ}がりで、{商品|しょうひん}{価格|かかく}に{数|すう}パーセントの{上乗|うわの}せが{避|さ}けられなくなった。
examples.english: Due to rising raw material costs, adding a few percent to product prices became unavoidable.

notes:
{上乗|うわの}せ is formed from {上|うわ} (on top) + {乗|の}せ (placing). It describes adding an extra amount to an existing total.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上乗|うわの}せする (to add on, to surcharge)
- {料金|りょうきん}の{上乗|うわの}せ (surcharge on fees)
- {価格|かかく}に{上乗|うわの}せする (add to the price)
- {上乗|うわの}せ{分|ぶん} (the added amount)
- {上乗|うわの}せ{料金|りょうきん} (surcharge fee)

USAGE:
- Very common in business and consumer contexts when discussing pricing
- Can also be used beyond money: {人員|じんいん}を{上乗|うわの}せする (add extra staff)
- {追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん} (additional fee) is a near-synonym but {上乗|うわの}せ emphasizes the "on top of" aspect
